meaning: Truth said of things goes with intelligibility (q.16 a.1, a.3), and intelligibility goes with being (q.16 a.3: each thing is knowable insofar as it has being); so a thing has truth exactly when it has being, and is more true exactly when it is more a being: Metaphysics II.1's 'as to being, so to truth'. A two-step chain through the distinct respect of intelligibility; both premises are OPEN readings supported by q.16 claims.
